theme_strategy: Hybrid Luxury Enterprise (Dark mode for impact sections like Hero/Cybersecurity, Light mode for readability in About/Services)

headings.styling: tracking-tight, leading-none, maximum text-6xl on desktop. Do NOT use Inter.
headings.usage: Hero headlines, section titles, bento card titles.

mono.usage: Overlines, stat counters, tech specs, tags, editorial marquee.

glassmorphism.rules: MUST use for sticky headers, dropdowns, and overlays. NEVER leave background completely transparent.

borders.radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for pills/buttons.

components_and_layouts.hero: Deep Blue (#0B1F4D) background. Kinetic typography with line-by-line reveal (Framer Motion). Contains a subtle 3D parallax element or abstract data network image. Overlay MUST be dark enough to read text.
components_and_layouts.bento_grids: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8). Mix span sizes (e.g., col-span-8, col-span-4). Items must be direct children.
components_and_layouts.header: Sticky navigation, z-50. Glassmorphism background. Must include Logo, Mega Menu, and CTA button. Not hidden behind hamburger on desktop.
components_and_layouts.marquee: Slow, smooth drift using react-fast-marquee. Use JetBrains Mono for a highly technical, editorial feel. Used for Certifications (CMMC, WOSB, etc.).
components_and_layouts.dashboard: High-density grid (gap-4). Cardless or 1px subtle border styles. Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match the brand.

motion_and_interaction.page_load: Masked line-by-line reveal for hero text. Staggered fade-up (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1) for grids.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1). Buttons must change background color and remain readable. NO universal 'transition: all' - target specific properties.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to WCAG AA. Text over images must have a gradient overlay or text-shadow.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: Every interactive element MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

hero_skyscraper.description: Premium corporate skyscraper for the main enterprise feel

cybersecurity.description: Modern server rack for CMMC and Zero Trust sections

professionals.description: High-end corporate meeting for staffing solutions

abstract_network.description: Abstract data lines for tech backgrounds or parallax hero elements

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a $50k+ luxury enterprise website. Avoid generic templates, standard centered layouts, and basic Bootstrap-like columns.
Implement a bold, kinetic hero section with line-by-line reveal using framer-motion.
Do NOT use Inter for headings. Apply Cabinet Grotesk or a similar premium geometric font.
Use lenis for momentum scrolling to make the site feel premium.
All cards must have generous padding (p-8 or p-12) and follow the bento grid protocol (asymmetrical spanning).
Integrate Shadcn UI for complex interactive components (forms, dashboard, selects) but style them without the 'Vercel default' look.
Ensure all testing attributes (data-testid) are present on buttons, links, and form elements.
Never apply a fully transparent background to the header or overlays. Always use a backdrop-blur + semi-transparent color.
Do not use dark colors for full-screen gradients. Keep backgrounds solid with subtle textures or grain.
Do not center-align the main App text. Use precise left-alignment with generous whitespace.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers over images.
